title: Notifications
preferences_desc: Select which channel you want to receive each type of notification. The in_app channel (bell) is always active. Only channels configured by the administrator are shown.
no_gateways_configured: No gateways configured. The administrator must activate at least one gateway (Email, Telegram, Matrix, etc.) so you can choose delivery channels. Meanwhile, you will receive notifications in the app bell.
contacts_desc: Your contact details to receive notifications through the different channels. This data is private and not shared.
quiet_hours_desc: During this range, notifications will not be sent via external gateways (email, telegram, etc.). In-app notifications (bell) are always delivered. Leave empty to disable.
digest_mode_desc: Choose how to receive email notifications. Instant sends each notification separately. Daily digest groups all notifications of the day into a single email (at 8:00 AM).
digest_daily: Daily digest (one email in the morning)
webpush_desc: Receive notifications directly in your browser, even when the app is not open. No third parties required - works with the W3C Push standard.
gateways_desc: Configure delivery gateways. Prioritize federated and free networks (Matrix, XMPP, Telegram) over proprietary channels.
webpush_not_supported: Your browser does not support push notifications
webpush_vapid_error: Could not get VAPID key from server
webpush_auto_desc: VAPID keys are generated automatically when a user activates push notifications from their contacts page. You do not need to configure anything here. Just activate the gateway and users can subscribe from their settings.
